evaluationUnit: date-symbol prediction with explicit eligible masks and date-balanced aggregation

balancedAccuracy.threshold: selected on earlier OOF dates only
balancedAccuracy.abstentions: excluded from directional confusion matrix and reported as coverage

mcc.undefined: null when the complete confusion-matrix denominator is zero

brierSkillScore.baseline: class prevalence estimated only from the corresponding training window; evaluation prevalence is legacy-only

top10DirectionHitRate.selection: top decile within each complete audited daily cross-section
top10DirectionHitRate.hit: net five-day return greater than zero

top10ProfitHitRate.selection: same daily top-decile set as top10DirectionHitRate
top10ProfitHitRate.hit: cost-adjusted actual return greater than zero

ndcgAt10.smallDatePolicy: dates with fewer than 30 eligible symbols are reported and excluded

expectedValue.components: target-first gain minus stop-first loss plus timeout net return
expectedValue.availability: null when the long-trade gate is inactive
